summary: Frontend E2E testing of Haul Yeah Moving Phase 1 marketing site. All critical flows verified: homepage SEO/title/meta/JSON-LD, no star/rating terms, Tally inline iframe + popup opens on Free Quote click, FAQ accordion toggle, service/location placeholder routes render (no 404), phone/sms links correct, mobile menu open/close, mobile CTA bar visible with correct links. robots.txt and sitemap.xml serve correctly (21 urls). Backend /api/ health = 200.
